---
applyTo: ".github/skills/**/*.md,.github/instructions/**/*.md,AGENTS.md"
---
# Agent Files — Concise

Files in `.github/skills/`, `.github/instructions/`, `AGENTS.md` must be concise and brief to keep context token efficient.

## Applies To

- `AGENTS.md`
- `.github/skills/**/*.md` (skill files and support docs)
- `.github/instructions/**/*.md` (instruction files)
- `.github/prompts/**/*.md` (prompt files)

## Exception

Security warnings + irreversible action confirmations → normal English. Resume conciseness after warning complete.
